title: Two-dimensional Taxonomy for N-ary Knowledge Representation Learning Methods
abstract: arXiv:2506.05626v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world knowledge can take various forms, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Among these, Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are structured representations that integrate heterogeneous data sources into structured representations. However, KGs typically reduce complex n-ary relations to simple triples, thereby losing higher-order relational details. In contrast, hypergraphs naturally represent n-ary relations with hyperedges that directly connect multiple entities. Recent advances have led to many hypergraph representation learning methods; however, they often overlook entity roles in hyperedges, limiting fine-grained semantic modelling. To address these issues, Knowledge Hypergraphs (KHGs) and Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs (HKGs) combine the advantages of KGs and hypergraphs to better capture complex relational structures and role-specific semantics of real-world knowledge. translated_title: N元知识表示学习方法的二维分类法
translated_abstract: 现实世界的知识可以呈现多种形式，包括结构化、半结构化和非结构化数据。其中，知识图谱是将异构数据源整合为结构化表示的结构化表示形式。然而，知识图谱通常将复杂的n元关系简化为简单的三元组，从而丢失了高阶关系的细节。相比之下，超图通过直接连接多个实体的超边自然地表示n元关系。近年来的研究进展催生了许多超图表示学习方法；然而，这些方法往往忽略了实体在超边中的角色，限制了细粒度的语义建模。为了解决这些问题，知识超图和超关系知识图谱结合了知识图谱和超图的优势，以更好地捕捉现实世界知识的复杂关系结构和角色特定语义。本综述提供了一个结构化的回顾……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本综述针对知识图谱将复杂n元关系简化为三元组而丢失高阶关系细节的问题，提出了N元知识表示学习方法的二维分类体系，系统梳理了知识超图（KHG）和超关系知识图谱（HKG）等融合知识图谱与超图优势的新兴方法。
en_tdlr: This survey proposes a two-dimensional taxonomy for N-ary knowledge representation learning methods, systematically covering Knowledge Hypergraphs (KHGs) and Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs (HKGs) that combine the strengths of knowledge graphs and hypergraphs to capture complex relational structures and role-specific semantics.
